brief: The viewer sees a vast, highly stylized architectural interior defined by intersecting geometric planes. The dominant feature is the ethereal glow of brilliant emerald green energy. This energy emanates from glowing arterial seams that pulse with visible, rhythmic waves. At the junction points of the planes, these green energies coalesce into highly charged nodes. The entire structure is perpetually dynamic; the planes visibly warp and bend around these nodes, while an overlying crystalline surface reacts to the energy buildup by fracturing and distorting, mapping the luminous power source across the architecture.

statement: This sketch depicts an ethereal architectural interior defined by intersecting geometric planes, infused with pulsating emerald green energy. The viewer observes a dynamic space where nodes—points of concentrated luminosity—pulse rhythmically and connect through glowing energy lines. The structure warps around these nodes as planes bend and shift, creating a sense of perpetual motion and energetic flow. The entire scene exists in a crystalline environment that reacts to the power source by distorting and fracturing, mapping the energy throughout the architecture. Through constant animation and interaction between elements, it conveys the feeling of an otherworldly space alive with charged, flowing forces.
